APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE TEK TULIPAN REZIDENCE
Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 2+1 i cili ndodhet ne Rezidencen Tulipan. Apartamenti eshte i pozicionuar ne katin perdhe te godines. Eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor,nje soxhorno spacioze ,dy dhoma gjumi,dy tualete me dritare dhe nje oborr. Ne cmim eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi. Prona dispononon kontrate porosie. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT TULIPAN RESIDENCE A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale located in Tulipan Residence. The apartment is located on the ground floor of the building. It is organized in a corridor, a spacious living room, two bedrooms, two bathrooms with windows and a yard. A parking post is included in the price. The property has an order contract. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
